post.caption: The Hope Diamond's setting went to vote. Harry Winston donated the Hope Diamond in 1958. In 2009, the museum let the public vote on a new setting. Harry Winston's firm designed three settings to choose from. More than 100,000 people voted online. Embracing Hope won, with 340 baguette diamonds in three rows. On September 23, 2009, it was shown with no setting at all. The new setting went on view in November 2010. In January 2012, it returned to its old setting. The stone weighs 45.52 carats in every setting.
